Package hadur117.core.melee

Class CrowdSurfer

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.melee.CrowdSurfer
public final class CrowdSurfer extends Object
The duel surfer's waves and danger views fed by several shooters at once (MSURF-1..3, and the engine TSURF shares). Each shooter keeps its own MoveController, so its waves and the views learned from its hits and passes stay its own across the battle, as a duel opponent's do. A shot becomes a duel wave aimed at Hadur as it was the tick before the shot left; a move to a point is rated by driving there with the engine's physics, the PRECISE heaviest waves by precise intersection and every other wave at the first tick it reaches Hadur on the way.

A wave weighs 1 / (1 + k)^2, where k counts the other robots nearer its shooter than Hadur was when it fired (a shot is most likely at the shooter's nearest robot); a wave under MIN_WEIGHT is dropped. A move's danger is expected damage: each wave's weight, times the bullet's damage, times the views' score at the intersection (plus the shooter's normalised hit rate on Hadur, as the duel surf adds it).

The class holds no opinion about where to go: the caller supplies the points (the crowd mover's ring) and adds its own crowd cost.
